主界面：聊天面板与工具调用可视化.message: Main interface: chat panel with tool call visualization

Chat 面板与预览面板协同工作.message: Chat panel working alongside the preview panel

聊天 / 代码 / 办公三种模式，自由切换。工具调用与思考过程全透明，实时可见。.message: Chat / Code / Office modes, freely switchable. Full transparency into tool calls and reasoning in real time.

新建、重命名、删除、分叉讨论。文件级与会话级变更追踪，随时回滚。.message: Create, rename, delete, fork discussions. File-level and session-level change tracking with rollback.

10+ 种内置工具：终端、浏览器、搜索、代码分析等，覆盖日常开发全场景。.message: 10+ built-in tools: terminal, browser, search, code analysis, covering all daily development scenarios.
